hero.title: Hi, I'm Pietro Dondi
hero.subtitle: Game Developer & Full-Time Dreamer
hero.description: Crafting immersive experiences with Unreal Engine 5, VR/AR magic, and endless creativity. Welcome to my interactive web portfolio.

about.p1: I'm a passionate, curious, and open-minded developer currently working at Ringmaster Reply as a Game Developer and Software Engineer.
about.p2: I have a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science Engineering from the University of Rome "Sapienza", where I specialized in Software Engineering and Game Development.
about.p3: I love games in general, from social ones, to table-top games to video games. Also, passionate about technology, physics, maths, cars, motorsport, and nature.
about.p4: Currently leading the development of Labyrinth, a game that I invented, and I am directing with a team of twelve game developers. We released this game on Steam the 31st of October 2025.

labyrainth.title: LABYRAINTH
labyrainth.blurb: My main game project that I directed from start to finish. A scifi FPS roguelite maze runner game for PC and VR devices, with online leaderboards. Released on Steam!
labyrainth.desc:
LABYRAINTH is a blend of new ideas and technologies put together with some imagination, using Unreal Engine 5 and C++, combining AI with VR, and arcade games with maze exploration.

Features of the game:
• FPS arcade roguelite scifi game set in a dark alien world made of labyrinths
• Play solo but participate in online leaderboards thanks to an asynchronous multiplayer system
• For both PC and VR devices
• Escape the mazes in the shortest time while fighting aliens, avoiding traps and activating powers
• 5 main game modes: Story, Infinite, Ranked, Survival, Creative

I am the lead developer of this project, responsible for the game design, the technical architecture, the game mechanics, and the VR integration.
I developed this game while working at my current company on other projects as well.
As the game leader I was responsible for managing the team, ensuring the overall quality of the game was met.
I have also overseen the marketing and the community management aspects of the game, ensuring a successful launch and ongoing player engagement.
We officially released the game on Steam the 31st of October 2025.

metarace.title: Metarace
metarace.blurb: Have you ever wanted to participate in horse races directly while riding a horse in VR?
metarace.desc:
Worked on a horse racing betting game for web3 platforms.

Features of the game:
• Horse racing betting game in 3D within a metaverse environment
• Oculus VR, OpenXR and Windows Mixed Reality integration
• Real-time multiplayer betting system with support for cryptocurrencies
• Customizable horses and tracks
• Support for NFTs and in-game purchases
• Stylized low poly art style with a focus on performance and accessibility

This project was developed as a proof of concept for a potential client, showcasing my ability to create engaging and immersive experiences in the metaverse space.

metaverse.title: Metaverse Platform
metaverse.blurb: An ambitious metaverse project where multiple 3D and VR games connect through a unified backend framework.
metaverse.desc:
An ambitious project that aimed to create a unified metaverse platform integrating multiple 3D online games into a single ecosystem.

Key Features:
• Multi-game integration with shared user profiles
• Advanced VR interaction systems
• Real-time multiplayer capabilities
• Cross-platform compatibility
• Dynamic world generation
• Web3 integration for in-game economies

I contributed to the development of the VR features of the metaverse, focusing on user interaction and adapting UI interaction in VR.
I also worked on one of the games integrated into the metaverse, a 3D chess game built in Unreal Engine with real-time multiplayer matches and a custom chess engine with support for AI opponents.

cas.title: Complex Adaptive System and Computational Models
cas.blurb: A computational model of an ant nest, simulating the interactions of multiple AI agents that behave like ants.
cas.desc:
Project for my thesis program at University "Sapienza" of Rome, awarded with top grades.

Technical Implementation:
• Java computational model simulating ant behaviors
• Genetic AI algorithms for ant reproduction
• Data visualization and analysis of ant emergent behaviors
• Intuitive and interactive user interface design

This project was backed by intensive studies on complex adaptive systems and especially social complex adaptive systems, and how they can be modeled using computational models.
The Java application simulates an ant nest where multiple simple AI agents that behave like ants interact with each other and with the environment, creating complex behaviors and emergent patterns not encoded in the system.
media: The computational model of an ant nest

ostomaze.title: OstoMaze
ostomaze.blurb: A pixelart dungeon crawler made with Unity, with the objective to help children with ostomy to learn while having fun.
ostomaze.desc:
OstoMaze is a simple game I developed for a university project, with two other colleagues, where the goal is to navigate a dungeon while avoiding obstacles and collecting items, that help the character with ostomy to be stronger and gain confidence in itself.

Features of the game:
• A 2D dungeon crawler game with a top-down view
• Minimalistic RPG mechanics with a focus on exploration and item collection
• Educational elements about ostomy care and confidence building
• Simple yet engaging gameplay mechanics
• Pixelart graphics with a focus on accessibility and inclusivity

This was my first ever experience in building and designing a video game. I came up with the idea of the game and designed the mechanics, while my colleagues worked on the graphics and animation.
I was responsible for the sound design, the SFX and VFX of the game and for the level design of the dungeons.
An Italian hospital oversaw the competition between multiple teams and awarded us with a prize for the best game, as it was the most fun and easy to play game for little children with ostomy.

webgames.title: Web Development & Web Games
webgames.blurb: From Vue.js gaming portals to browser games built with Three.js and PlayCanvas — three years of shipping for the web.
webgames.desc:
For three years at Ringmaster Reply I led the front-end work on web gaming portals hosting online prize games. I owned the full front-end lifecycle: gathering requirements from clients, designing the software and its UI/UX, developing, testing, releasing and maintaining it — primarily with Vue.js, JavaScript, HTML and CSS.

Recently I moved into web-based game development itself, building browser games with TypeScript, Three.js, Tween.js and PlayCanvas.

Earlier I also shipped an Android app blending gamification and AR: the phone camera recognizes real-world objects (CameraX + MLKit) and makes them interactive in-app (ARCore), backed by Firebase.

On the side: a markdown-to-HTML docs generator, static utility sites, and the engine behind this portfolio.

aiagents.title: AI Automations & Agents
aiagents.blurb: n8n pipelines and autonomous LLM agents — like FindAJob, a 4-agent system that analyzes postings, adapts resumes ATS-proof, and writes custom outreach.
aiagents.desc:
FindAJob is an n8n + TypeScript system that parses job platforms, extracts and categorizes every posting, and filters them against custom parameters.

Four AI agents then run asynchronously and autonomously:
• one analyzes the job
• one adapts your resume to be ATS-proof for that specific posting
• one writes a custom cover letter
• one drafts the outreach message

Deliberately no auto-apply — a human always sends.

I also run AIforBusinesses, an operations hub where AI agents assist a full website-production pipeline — the same system that renovated this very site.
